channel.title: SyncGlass
channel.description: Updates of SyncGlass. .github/workflows/publish-release.yml adds an item for each published release.

item.description:
Added

  • Software updates through Sparkle. SyncGlass checks for a new version once a week. The welcome screen and Settings > General turn the weekly check on or off; Check for Updates in the panel's menu checks at once. When the weekly check finds an update, the menu item reads "Update to X.Y.Z…" until you open it.

Changes since v0.1.0

  • f4d41dd Version bump to v0.2.0 (build 2)
  • 5a7b96b Link the latest SyncGlass.zip at the top of the README
  • 13cff13 Give the appcast tests their own empty appcast
  • 37539ff Fail publish-release when the new appcast item is unsigned
  • cbdcf6f Release v0.1.0 (automatic appcast update)
  • cd6f8ea Describe updates in the README and the changelog
  • b9cc8ef Add published releases to a Sparkle appcast
  • be797c3 Check for updates with Sparkle
  • 6c3910d Run the unit tests in the build workflow
  • b8037d1 Test bin/changelog.py
  • 12fd5be Test the snapshot, the menu-bar symbol, the panel text and the Recent list format
  • c9c273d Test the path filters, the implicit-package check and size formatting
  • 67e5314 Reword the credits in the README
  • d84c006 Add a test target with tests for ItemState
  • c45f393 Move the in-flight decision into ItemState.phase
  • 72de4c7 Show the notarized-download badge for runs from release tags

Full diff: https://github.com/alberti42/SyncGlass/compare/v0.1.0...v0.2.0

Added

  • Menu-bar icon that shows whether iCloud Drive is idle, uploading, downloading or syncing changes from other devices. The icon is monochrome and follows light and dark mode. An optional mode fills the cloud as files finish.
  • Panel with the files in transfer and the recently transferred files. Each file in transfer shows its upload or download percentage, read from the progress that iCloud Drive publishes. Each recent file shows when its transfer finished.
  • File Info window with the iCloud state of a file (status, live percentage, conflicts, errors, sharing), its last recorded transfer, and every date macOS keeps for it.
  • Notifications when uploads or downloads finish, with a minimum transfer time and a choice of sound.
  • Include and exclude filters as regular expressions matched against the full path.
  • Scan for Transfers, which finds files that started uploading before SyncGlass was running.
  • History log of finished transfers.
  • Open at login through a login helper registered with SMAppService.
  • App icon: a magnifying glass over a half-filled cloud.

Changes in this first release

  • 6b20e94 Release v0.1.0 with the app icon
  • ad8d02d Add the app icon
  • 0139702 Skip files that are not in iCloud
  • 287dd2d Version bump to v0.1.0 (build 1)
  • fc6baea Initial release of SyncGlass
